proposal.title: Content-contract additions for a graded subject
proposal.detail:
Front matter additions:
- curriculum: codes as in (a).
- assessment: numeric (from subject.yaml).
- safety_flags: subset of [suicide_selfharm, eating, substances, sexuality, violence].
- content_note: required when any flag is set.
- materials: list of {url, title, publisher, licence_class: open-cc-by | open-cc-by-sa | link-out | excluded, licence (exact), audience, read (date)}. 'excluded' entries are kept for the record but never rendered.
- exam_tasks: list of {id, type, part (A20 | B20 | C30), points, minutes, codes}.
- review_status: {teacher: none | date, health_professional: none | date, safe_messaging: none | date}.
- sibling_links: links to the OP site, with read dates.

Section order (H2): Opiskelijalle; Tehtävät; Pohdinta; Koetehtävät; Mallivastaukset; Itseopiskelun askel; Tuntisuunnitelma (75/60/45); Eriyttäminen; Apua ja tukea (replaces 'Milloin opinto-ohjaajalle'); Linkitetyt materiaalit (generated from materials, with licence class); Lähteet (generated).

Koetehtävät: 2-3 original tasks per topic in the YTL task types (true/false set, error identification of 5 items at 4 p each, comparison on aspects, table completion, theory application, figure or material analysis, ethical analysis, research plan). Each task heading carries points and minutes. Material is self-written and labelled kuvitteellinen, or a linked open or official source; never quoted text from publishers or YTL.

Mallivastaukset: per task:
- a model answer in original wording;
- Pisteytys: content points by required elements plus an information-processing rubric (concepts, application, analysis, evaluation, argumentation, structure) split 50/50;
- Tyypilliset virheet;
- a fixed line saying the scoring is the site's own practice guidance, not YTL's.

Build checks (fail the build):
1. Every Koetehtävä id has a matching Mallivastaus with a points total equal to the task's points.
2. Every exam_tasks code exists, and every TE1 objective and content code is covered by at least one topic and at least one exam task.
3. Every 'Osaan' outcome is named in a task step or exam task.
4. Every materials entry has a licence_class and a read date under 12 months old. open-cc-by-sa and link-out content is never inlined (the existing external-resource check).
5. No n-gram overlap with YTL task text (a check against a locally stored hash list of the linked hvp pages, optional and later).
6. If safety_flags is non-empty: a content_note is present, an 'Apua ja tukea' section has 112 plus the official help links with dates, and a health-figure scanner blocks kg, kcal, BMI, grams, portions, doses, promille and units, and hours or minutes next to sleep or activity words. Exemptions are whitelisted per line with a reason, as stable_figures is now.
7. A privacy linter flags task prompts in first-person health disclosure forms ('kerro oma', 'kuinka paljon sinä', 'nosta käsi jos') for checker review (warning, not fail).
8. The review_status banner renders on every page while any reviewer field is none (the CLAUDE.md requirement).
9. Yearly-facts keys added: ravitsemussuositus, liikkumissuositus, unisuositus, alkoholilaki, tupakkalaki, huumausainelaki, opiskeluterveydenhuolto, kriisipuhelimet, kouluterveyskysely.

Checker-only rules (not automatable): no method details, neutral suicide wording, no fear arousal, inclusive examples, fictional cases in groups, and a 'pass' option on reflective tasks. Rules from safety research that are model-derived must be marked [M] in the contract.

proposal.title: Expert review plan
proposal.detail:
Reviewers (all human, recruited by the operator [O]; the agents only prepare packets):
(1) A terveystieto teacher (lukio, ideally a YO grader): curriculum fidelity per topic code, whether the exam tasks match YTL task types and difficulty, the model answers and scoring guides, the 75/60/45 lesson feasibility, and the TE2 preview links.
(2) A health professional (e.g. a student health care nurse or doctor): every health fact, recommendation link, service description (wellbeing services counties, opiskeluterveydenhuolto after the autumn-2026 reform) and help box. Checks that nothing reads as medical advice.
(3) A safe-messaging reviewer (a mental-health professional, e.g. MIELI-trained, or an eating-disorder specialist): topics 04, 08, 09, plus any page with safety_flags; the content notes and help boxes.
(4) An inclusion and sexuality-education reviewer (e.g. Seta or Väestöliitto trained): topics 06, 07 and the images.
(5) Optional: a student panel (2-3 lukio students, anonymous feedback, no health disclosure) for readability.

Process:
The producer generates one review packet per reviewer: the rendered pages, the print version, a checklist mapped to contract rules, and the list of [M] rules. Reviewers return findings in a plain table (topic id, section, severity must/should/nit, claim, suggested fix, source). The operator chooses the channel: e-mail or a GitHub issue template; no personal data is committed, and reviewers are credited only by role unless they opt in.
The producer turns the table into a fix brief (written-before). Builders fix; a checker who did not write the fix verifies; the judge rules on the final round's open items.
review_status front matter is set per topic only when all must-items for that reviewer are closed. The banner disappears only when the teacher and the health professional have both signed off. A diary entry records it.
Re-review is triggered when a yearly fact changes or a topic's text changes by more than a set threshold.
